products.description:
Glazing is what separates greenhouses at this size, and the Bellerose uses 10mm 4-wall polycarbonate rated at R-2.1, retaining 30% more heat than the standard 6mm twin-wall panels. It diffuses the light coming through, so plants get coverage without scorching.
The frame is FSC-certified kiln-dried cedar, which naturally resists rot, decay and insects. Inside there are 83 square feet of floor and 40 linear feet of staging shelves, some fixed and some foldable, and the entry door is sized wide enough for a wheelbarrow. A water spigot is fitted inside for watering without dragging a hose in.
Airflow is handled two ways, by one thermostat-activated exhaust fan and two casement windows. An integrated pergola with a trellis roof defines the entrance for climbing vines and hanging plants. Pro-Tect tested to 5,700 pounds of snow load and 100 mph winds, with a 5-year warranty backed by U.S.-based support.

products.title: Ford 6.7L CP4 to DCR Pump Conversion
products.description:
The CP4 high-pressure pump fitted to Ford Super Duty diesels has a known failure mode, and when it lets go, debris travels downstream through the fuel system rather than staying in the pump. That pattern has drawn recalls and litigation across the manufacturers using it.
This kit replaces the CP4 with a DCR pump developed by S&S Diesel Motorsport together with PurePower Technologies, the aftermarket division of Stanadyne. It drops into the original location with OE fit and function, so no custom tuning or fabrication is needed, and it is emissions compliant under CARB EO D-756-7. Coverage spans model years 2011 through 2025 across the Ford F250 to F750 range fitted with the 6.7L Power Stroke diesel.
products.excerpt: A direct-replacement DCR fuel pump that retires the factory CP4 on 2011 through 2025 Ford 6.7L Power Stroke trucks.

Output is 3,500 starting watts and 3,000 running watts, delivered through pure sine wave inverter technology, so laptops, phones, and televisions can be plugged in alongside tools. The enclosure is built around quiet operation, which counts at a campsite or beside a house overnight.

products.description:
A 3,800-pound machine with an EPA-certified Kubota D902 three-cylinder diesel behind the cab, producing 15.8 horsepower at 2,200 rpm and up to 20.4 horsepower at 3,600 rpm when a hard pass calls for it. products.title: Zero-Turn Mower 54 in. Complete Bagging System for Z500 Series
products.description:
Everything needed to collect clippings off a 54-inch deck arrives together: an attachment bar and hitch, a High-Performance PowerFlow blower, the chute and the hopper assembly. The ballast weights required for safe operation are included, so nothing else has to be ordered.
The blower moves material up the chute without bogging down, and a fill indicator on the chute signals when the bags are getting full. Capacity is 6.5 bushels, roughly 229 liters, split across two bags that lift out for emptying. Standard mower blades work with it, so no blade swap is needed. It fits John Deere Z515E and Z530M machines with a 54-inch deck and measures 51 inches wide, 45 tall and 26 deep.
products.excerpt: Complete two-bag collection system for 54-inch decks, with a PowerFlow blower, chute, hopper and the required ballast weights.
